# RallyHub

RallyHub is an Ireland-focused pickleball platform for players, clubs, venues, sessions, events and competition management.

Primary public resources:
- https://rallyhub.ie/directory — all-Ireland pickleball club directory
- https://rallyhub.ie/pickleball-clubs/clare — pickleball clubs and venues in County Clare
- https://rallyhub.ie/pickleball-clubs/galway — pickleball clubs and venues in County Galway
- https://rallyhub.ie/events — Irish pickleball events and tournament area
- https://rallyhub.ie/directory/story — what the RallyHub Directory is
- https://rallyhub.ie/directory/help — club guide and Directory help

Public club pages use URLs like:
- https://rallyhub.ie/directory/{club-slug}

Public venue pages use URLs like:
- https://rallyhub.ie/pickleball-venues/{club-slug}/{venue-id}

RallyHub Directory information includes club names, counties, venues, addresses, court information, weekly sessions, contact information and club-supplied updates where available. Clubs may be verified or unclaimed; visitors should contact a club before travelling because schedules can change.

RallyHub supports all 32 counties on the island of Ireland and is intended to help people find where and when to play pickleball.
